Step through a portal where scars become songs and healing becomes a celebration. Blending folk concert, musical, immersive ritual, and joyous dance party, Wholly Unwinding transforms the audience into fellow travelers on a journey of radical self-discovery. Come ready to move, sing, and discover what becomes possible when every body belongs.

What new worlds emerge when a classic is reimagined through accessibility from the very beginning? Opera Praktikos transforms Bellini & Romani's La Sonnambula (The Sleepwalker) into a richly integrated experience where spoken, sung, and signed languages become one expressive whole. Familiar and startlingly new, this reimagining reveals how inclusion doesn't simply expand a story - it transforms its meaning.
